rules.description: PFMS must create payment files for each received lot and send them to the relevant State/UT Units for verification and digital signature.
rules.outcome: Payment files are created and pushed to the concerned State/UT Units for verification and appending Digital signature
rules.evidence_quote: On receipt of lots, PFMS will create payment files against these lots and push them to concerned State/UT Units for verification and appending Digital signature.

rules.description: After the State/UT Units digitally sign the payment files, the files must be made available to the Program Division (PD) makers.
rules.condition: Once digitally signed by the concerned State/UT Units
rules.outcome: Payment files are made available to the Program Division (PD) makers
rules.evidence_quote: Once digitally signed by the concerned State/UT Units, payment files will be made available to the Program Division (PD) makers.

rules.description: All activities related to payment file generation, verification, signing, and distribution must be completed by a specified deadline.
rules.condition: During the payment file generation process
rules.outcome: These activities will be completed by 10th November
rules.evidence_quote: These activities will be completed by 10th November,
